title: Bumper: Zoo's One Fix
mood: helpful, resolved: the major motif clicks into D6/9

hits.what: the fix clicks into place (D6/9, harp lift)

description: Segment bumper for Zoo's One Fix, built from Zoo's motif (3.0 s).
usage: Cut on the downbeat at the segment change: the file starts with two frames of silence, so start it at downbeatStartFrame(cue, cutFrame) (2 frames early). The music is finished before the file ends. -16 LUFS-I.
selfReview: The major motif (D D A G# F#) on vibes and piano, then a rim click and a harp lift into D6/9 (critic round 1: it was labelled Dmaj9, but there is no major 7th under the tonic). The exposed FM-EP chord has 2 dB less 400 Hz. -16 LUFS-I, -2.0 dBTP after AAC, 3.4 LU lost on the phone model. Critic round 2 (2026-11-24): Harp +0.1 c median (n 9, 0 beyond 10 c) (critic: -11.2 c median, 6 of 9 beyond -10 c); the master limiter does not work (0.0 dB). -1.4 dBTP after AAC 128k (worst of ten).
